intro: Luna 16 touched down in Mare Fecunditatis on September 20, 1970 — the first robotic sample return from another world, drilled 35 cm into the lunar regolith, sealed 101 g into the return capsule, and lifted off 26 hours after landing. The capsule landed in Kazakhstan three days later. Demonstrated that Soviet engineering could return lunar material without crewed flight, a year and two months after Apollo 11.
